source: public: BMW M47 2.0d (early) uses Bosch EDC15C under BMW's 'DDE4' designation; DDE4=EDC15 is a documented BMW mapping

source: public: BMW M57 3.0d (early) spans Bosch EDC15C (DDE4) then EDC16 (DDE5) across its production; both generations documented for M57
notes: Engine family M57/M57D30 (early). TWO ECU generations: EDC15C (DDE4) on the earliest cars, EDC16 (DDE5) later — family lists both as a candidate set; the year split is NOT resolved here. addresses omitted because early cars are K-line. No part_numbers shipped.
